-- Try calculating CPI with conservation status weighted
-- Conservestatus: Critical=5, Poor=4, Fair=3, Good=2, Excellent=1 (higher = more urgent)
SELECT 
    a.artregistry,
    a.artname,
    a.artdynasty,
    ar.histsignrating,
    ar.researchvalrating,
    ar.cultscore,
    a.conservestatus,
    CASE a.conservestatus 
        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 5 
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 4 
        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 3 
        WHEN 'Good' THEN 2 
        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 
    END as status_score,
    -- CPI formula: normalize and combine
    ROUND((ar.histsignrating * 10 + ar.researchvalrating * 10 + ar.cultscore + CASE a.conservestatus 
        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 50 
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 40 
        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 30 
        WHEN 'Good' THEN 20 
        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 10 
    END)::numeric, 2) as cpi_score
FROM artifactscore a
JOIN artifactratings ar ON a.artregistry = ar.artref
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH cpi_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry,
        a.artname,
        a.artdynasty,
        ar.histsignrating,
        ar.researchvalrating,
        ar.cultscore,
        CASE a.conservestatus 
            WHEN 'Critical' THEN 5 
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 4 
            WHEN 'Fair' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Good' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 
        END as status_weight

)
SELECT 
    artregistry,
    artname,
    artdynasty,
    ROUND((histsignrating + researchvalrating + cultscore + status_weight * 10)::numeric / 2.2, 2) AS score
FROM cpi_calc
ORDER BY score DESC;
